title: Forced active work accounting
objective: Kill active work; the educational test may pass while user impact is interrupted.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: A modern browser can open the complete local HTML/JS bundle with JavaScript enabled
Four fixed attempted transition journeys: two requests and two jobs, old-v1 to new-v2
A fixed original synthetic journey budget of 1000 ms; no actual host or service limit is implied
Termination, active work, epochs, retry and effect observations are DATA ONLY, never operations
actions: Choose forced, orderly or gap teaching data and predict the synthetic user outcome
Start four fixed active-work records, apply one fixed trace, then check the ledger
Inspect separate educational verification, user impact, cleanup and measured accounting
Reset the current rehearsal with retained history and allowance; keyboard actions are supported

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory page session; reset preserves all starts and allowance. Reload begins a new synthetic session.
syntheticInputs.counterQualification: Lost, retried, duplicated and late counts can overlap; unique interrupted outcomes are counted per journey, never by summing these categories.

expectedAssertions: Forced termination DATA detects and counts lost, retried, duplicated and unresolved work
An expected-interruption educational pass is visibly distinct from successful migration
Orderly DATA yields four correct timely new-epoch completions; gap DATA yields four unknown outcomes
A wrong success prediction fails without erasing measured interruption
Uninterrupted + interrupted + unknown equals all attempted journeys, including cancellations
Typed guards reject coercion, accessors, malformed state, unexpected fields, phase skips and a fifth start
Reset retains losses and unresolved work, restores defaults and keyboard focus, and never shadows form.reset
Actual DOM interactions, errors, failure, keyboard, reset and enforced CSP are observed
limits: No exercise action kills a process or invokes shell, file, network or resource operations
No native Azure, uninterrupted user migration, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 or statistical reliability certification
IaC N/A; no cloud, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, spending, packages or framework
Existing Node 22.23.4 tooling, offline Playwright 1.56.1 and Microsoft-signed Edge 156.0.4314.50 only
openIsolatedLesson is used with awaited finally close; the abandoned lifecycle prototype remains unqualified
Normal tests are read-only; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 explicitly enables deliberate producer capture
Raw CRLF source preservation and canonical immutable Git-source integrity are separate checks

acceptance.workerResult: Worker verification/publication only; parent empirical acceptance pending
acceptance.credit: At most one frozen A-S100 S unit; tests, repairs, evidence and tooling earn zero extra original credits
acceptance.nativeSibling: B-S100 is separate; D-S100, D-S042, D-S049 and BASE native/source obligations remain incomplete
